name: Beer City Metal Works & Construction
old_description: Beer City Metal Works is West Michigan's leading metal fabrication and custom miscellaneous metal works company. From architectural metal works, stair railings, custom furniture and fixtures to custom signage, bar tops, shelving and ornamental metals. BCMW does it all.
about:
Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Beer City Metal Works & Construction operates as a metal fabrication and custom miscellaneous metal works company. The business serves commercial construction projects across the Midwest, with a focus on architectural metalwork, stair railings, custom furniture, fixtures, signage, bar tops, shelving, and ornamental metals.

The shop provides end-to-end fabrication services, taking projects from initial concept sketches through CAD drawings to full 3D renderings before production. Its capabilities cover custom signage, ornamental metals, and architectural metalwork, supporting general contractors on miscellaneous metals packages. The team, led by General Manager and Lead Fabricator Jon Counterman, emphasizes proactive communication throughout each project.

Primary customers are general contractors and commercial construction firms throughout the Midwest. The company has supplied miscellaneous metals for a range of commercial builds, including architectural elements, stair systems, and custom interior fixtures such as bar tops and shelving.

Beer City Metal Works differentiates itself by prioritizing communication as a core project requirement and by offering design support that bridges napkin sketches to production-ready models. This approach aims to reduce misunderstandings and streamline the path from idea to installed metalwork.
